name: OXBench
description: A benchmark dataset of reference protein multiple sequence alignments used to evaluate the accuracy of MSA methods.
evaluation_method: alignment_score (SP-score and TC-score; i.e., sum-of-pairs and total-column accuracy)
typical_sota_score: varies by family and difficulty; typically reported in the range 70–95% (dataset-dependent)
reputation: A well-known reference benchmark in the multiple sequence alignment (MSA) community used to evaluate alignment accuracy of MSA algorithms.
notes: Non-LLM, domain-specific benchmark that uses specialized alignment metrics (SP/TC); performance varies widely across protein families and easy cases can saturate; relatively small and curated reference alignments.
